items.item_text: Must have a minimum of six months' experience in an acute care Surgery Department and be able to perform as the scrub personnel in all specialties. Six months experience may substituted if the candidate has completed an ORT externship on-site within the last year. If operational conditions permit, training a candidate without the required experience may be considered, but must be a recent Graduate from an OR Tech Program and certified. If Military trained, in lieu of ORT Certification/NCCT, a minimum of 10 years of Military Surgical Tech Experience is required.

Demonstrates the ability to safely and competently perform tasks and procedures according to Medical Center policy and procedure. Including, but not limited to: Demonstrates proficiency in the role of Scrub Technician. Supports Clinical Practice Standards. Demonstrates good judgment in utilizing resource personnel. Provides assistance to Nursing and attendant personnel. Adapts to change and problem-solving on a daily basis.

Demonstrates the ability to safely and competently use equipment in the provision of department services: Assures equipment is in operating order prior to use. Uses the following equipment in accordance with manufacturer's operating instructions. Including, but not limited to: CUSA Neuro Suction Irrigator. Microsopes for various clinical services. Power equipment including drills, saws (ie Midas Rex; Senthes; Stryker). Autoclaves & Steris. Instrument Washer/Decontaminator & Sonic. Other specialty equipment based on clinical service & competency sign-off.
